newsitem.title: USA: HLD Keystone Automotive acquires company.
newsitem.headline: HLD Keystone Automotive acquires company.

text.p: Keystone Automotive Industries Tuesday said it has acquired All Makes Body Parts Inc, a Phoenix-based distributor of automobile collission replacement parts with annual revenues of about $8 million.
Terms of the transaction were not disclosed.

The purchase marks Keystone's eighth acquisition in 12 months and boosts the number of its U.S. service centers to 77. "It provides the company with significant geographic expansion in the Southwestern United States, where we had a limited presence," Charles Hogarty, chief executive officer, said in a statement.
Keystone Automotive distributes its products in the United States primarily to collision repair shops.
